source: Real renderer in the demo harness, headless Chrome at 2x, light theme. Sample data: the fictional Pellwood launch review. The loops, the film and its poster were taken from the 0.1.0 code (alex/website-build, demo/video's scenes); each still made from the 0.2.0 code says how in its own source. The sidebar footer's status (small.en on Metal, 0 requests) was supplied to the harness, which has no main process; it is what a packaged build shows at rest.

files.name: live-window-2240.webp
files.shows: The hero: the live view mid-conversation, with the line, a mark for each question asked, and the topic lanes.
files.alt: Oats recording a launch review at 11:09. One line draws the conversation, with marks where an unknown, an unanswered and an answered question were asked. Below it, three topics as lanes: Pellwood launch date decision, SAML clock skew fix, and SOC 2 audit timeline, the one the room is on.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only site-live --themes light` (a 1120x700 window; the review replayed live from 11:05 with the line and the lanes, taken at 11:09), the top 616 CSS px at 2x: `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 0 0 2240 1232`.

files.name: live-window-1120.webp
files.shows: The same live view at half size, for narrow screens.
files.alt: Oats recording a launch review at 11:09. One line draws the conversation, with marks where an unknown, an unanswered and an answered question were asked. Below it, three topics as lanes: Pellwood launch date decision, SAML clock skew fix, and SOC 2 audit timeline, the one the room is on.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only site-live --themes light` (a 1120x700 window; the review replayed live from 11:05 with the line and the lanes, taken at 11:09), the top 616 CSS px at 2x: `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 0 0 2240 1232` `-resize 1120 616`.

files.name: topic-lanes.webp
files.shows: The Conversation flow card in its lanes view, just after the room went back to the first topic.
files.alt: Conversation flow at 12:33, three topics and one return to an earlier topic. The line steps down from Pellwood launch date decision to SAML clock skew fix and SOC 2 audit timeline, then goes back up to Pellwood launch date decision, where the room is now.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only site-topics --themes light` (a 1120x700 window; the review replayed live from 12:30, taken at 12:33), the card alone at 2x: `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 164 710 1912 372`.

files.name: check-live.webp
files.shows: A recording where the context check answers an unknown question from the team's notes, with the line, the topic lanes and the transcript around it.
files.alt: A recording at 8:33. Under the question Do we have a date from the auditors yet, asked 17 seconds earlier and marked Unknown, Oats shows Found it: Fieldwork starts November 10, from soc2-plan.md, Auditor dates. The transcript below has the reply: I don't know yet.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only site-check --themes light` (an 880x900 window, the app's narrowest; `check=1` turns the context check on with the harness's team folder, demo/harness/context.mjs; the review replayed live from 7:50 with the transcript shown, taken at 8:33), the window below its top bar at 2x: `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 16 104 1728 1592`.

files.name: conversation-finished.webp
files.shows: The finished conversation as it opens: its title, how the questions ended, the shape of the talk with each question in its place, and talk time per person.
files.alt: The finished conversation, Enterprise launch review: SSO gates the date. 29 minutes, 9 speakers, 3 marked moments, and 15 questions: 9 answered, 3 unknown, 2 unanswered, 1 open. Below, the shape of the conversation with each question in its place, and talk time for each person, from Maya at 18 percent to Omar at 2 percent.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only site-after --themes light` (the app's default 1200x800 window, the review opened), the reading column from the back link to talk time at 2x: `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 680 104 1504 1244`.

files.name: sidebar-foot.webp
files.shows: Crop of the sidebar's foot: where processing runs, the speech model and the network request count, above the wheat field.
files.alt: The bottom of the Oats sidebar: Settings, then On this Mac, small.en on Metal and 0 network requests since launch, above a dithered sky and wheat field.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only sidebar-foot --themes light` (harness `footer=small.en`: small.en loaded on Metal, 0 requests, what a packaged build shows at rest), the sidebar's last 352 CSS px at 2x, `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 0 1096 464 704`.
